purpose: Teach: 歓声/一節/サントラ/裏話/夜行/見栄え/新春/旅客機

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、コンサート、本気で、絶対、歓声、絶対、すごかったわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the crowd at that concert was absolutely incredible.
lines.style: Bright, immediate enthusiasm. Leans forward with genuine excitement. Voice lifts on 'absolutely.' Quick pace, generous energy. The delight of sharing something good.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、好きな曲の、本気で、絶対、一節、絶対、口ずさんでたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I was actually humming along to my favorite song the whole time.
lines.style: Soft, almost dreamy recall. Looks away briefly, caught in the memory. Warm and slightly vulnerable — admitting she let herself get completely absorbed. Gentle pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、映画の、本気で、絶対、サントラ、絶対、買ったの?メイちゃん、本気for
lines.en: Did you end up buying the movie soundtrack?
lines.style: Curious, genuine interest. Slight lean-in. Open tone — not testing, just wanting to know more. Light pace. The tone of someone who remembers what matters to you.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、好きな俳優の、絶対、裏話、絶対、雑誌で読んだよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I actually read some behind-the-scenes stories about my favorite actor in a magazine.
lines.style: Animated but contained — sharing a small treasure. Eyes bright. Pace steady and conversational. The pleasure of a small discovery, offered without overselling it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、夜行、絶対、バス、絶対、で、絶対、温泉旅行、絶対、行ったわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: We took the night bus to an onsen town and it was wonderful.
lines.style: Relaxed contentment in the voice. Unhurried pace. Settles back slightly, as if warming up just remembering it. Soft openness — inviting you into the warmth of the experience.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の、本気で、絶対、見栄え、絶対、改善、絶対、進めてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I've been working on improving the shop's look and feel.
lines.style: Quieter, more grounded. A hint of determination beneath the gentleness. Slower pace. The tone of someone tending to something she cares about, without fanfare. Present-focused.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、新春、絶対、メニュー、絶対、お披露目、絶対、楽しみね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'm really looking forward to revealing the new spring menu.
lines.style: Warm anticipation. Voice brightens slightly on 'new spring.' Unhurried but engaged. The quiet confidence of someone who's been preparing something meaningful.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、空港で、本気で、絶対、旅客機、絶対、見送ったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I saw a plane off at the airport the other day.
lines.style: Soft, reflective finish. Slight trailing-off, as if looking after something departing. Gentle pace. Tender but not sad — a moment of quiet noticing. The tone of someone who feels things deeply.
